module TopModule (
    input  a,
    input  b,
    input  c,
    input  d,
    output q
);

    // Combinational assignment based on the truth table
    assign q = (a & b & c & d) |
               (a & b & c & ~d) |
               (a & b & ~c) |
               (~a & b & c & ~d) |
               (~a & b & c & d) |
               (~a & b & ~c) |
               (~a & ~b & ~c & d) |
               (~a & ~b & ~c & ~d);

endmodule
